schema: Native FMZ simulated tick research supplement / provenance and marked P&L

scope.month: Original Aug 2021 Binance BTC/USDT no-leverage saved scope is interpreted as UTC. The isolated official VM simulates ticks and depth from FMZ candles. OHLC is cross-checked against official Binance. The exchange maintenance gap is explicit.
scope.matched_day: The 1 August comparison keeps the archived starting wallet, symbol, fees and source. The recorded adapter starts when the first usable book is seen, around six seconds after 00:00 UTC. Observability and fill rules differ.
scope.metrics: Marked equity is available plus frozen quote and all BTC valued at the final last price. Before-fee marked P&L adds reported commissions back on the same executed path. The sampled worst drawdown is a lower bound. Both drawdown ratios have fractional units. No win rate or closed-trade P&L can be derived from native aggregate snapshots.
scope.limits: These are comparative diagnostic receipts. Real order queue, execution impact and exact native fill-by-fill attribution remain outside this supplement.
